integrations.title: Integrations and Setup Guides
integrations.subtitle: Learn how to integrate KolayXport with your e-commerce infrastructure and manage your data.
integrations.generalApproachDesc: KolayXport offers a flexible integration model to centralize your e-commerce operations.
integrations.directIntegrationsDesc: Transfer your order and product data to KolayXport by integrating directly with the following platforms
integrations.apiKeyWarning: If you press "Refresh API KEY", your integration will be disconnected.
integrations.generalApproachP1: KolayXport offers a flexible integration model to centralize your e-commerce operations. With our direct integrations, you can pull order and product data from Turkey's leading marketplaces, Trendyol and Hepsiburada.
integrations.generalApproachP2: For access to a wider range of platforms, you can connect your existing Veeqo or Shippo accounts to KolayXport. This way, you can receive data from the many international marketplaces and e-commerce platforms supported by Veeqo and Shippo. You can find detailed information on how to connect your Veeqo and Shippo accounts on our "How to Use" page.
integrations.generalApproachP3: For shipments created through KolayXport, we currently use FedEx shipping integration.
integrations.generalApproachP4: Below you can find the direct integrations we support and the types of platforms accessible through Veeqo/Shippo. To manage your API keys and set up connections, visit your <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink> page.
integrations.etsyChromeDesc: Import your Etsy Shop Manager orders with a secure Chrome extension. No API required, automatic sync.
integrations.etsyChromeGuideLink: Click to see the setup guide
integrations.trendyolDesc: To connect your Trendyol store data to KolayXport, follow the steps in the <link>Trendyol Integration Guide</link> section.
integrations.hepsiburadaDesc: The Hepsiburada integration guide will be added soon. This integration will require API credentials from your Hepsiburada seller panel.
integrations.veeqoPlatformsDesc: By connecting your existing Veeqo account to KolayXport (details on the "How to Use" page), you can pull data from popular e-commerce platforms and marketplaces that Veeqo integrates with, such as:
integrations.veeqoPlatformsNote: These lists contain the major platforms. For Veeqo's up-to-date and complete integration list, please check Veeqo's official resources. KolayXport can receive data from these platforms through your Veeqo account.
integrations.veeqoImportantNoteDesc: Veeqo integration connects all marketplaces through Amazon. This way, there is no risk of your confidential information being leaked and no risk of your account being suspended due to the integration.
integrations.veeqoStep1Desc: Go to Veeqo.com. When you click "Sign up" (green button), you'll be directed to the registration screen. You can create an account with your email or sign in with Amazon.
integrations.veeqoStep2Desc: After creating your email and password, fill in the company information form that appears.
integrations.veeqoStep2Example: Example Information (you can use this if you don't have a US address):
integrations.veeqoStep2ConnectStore: Click "Connect store" to connect your first store.
integrations.veeqoStep3Desc: Click "Connect store" to connect your first store. Select the marketplace you want to connect from the list (e.g.: Etsy).
integrations.veeqoStep3Instructions: Follow the instructions that appear. You don't need to do anything with the codes here, just click "Next" to continue.
integrations.veeqoStep3EtsyAuth: You'll be redirected to the Etsy page. Sign in with your Etsy username and password, then click "Give authorization".
integrations.veeqoStep4Desc: After successfully connecting your first store, your orders will start appearing on the Veeqo dashboard.
integrations.veeqoStep5Desc: Click "Chat with us" from the question mark (?) menu in the top right corner.
integrations.veeqoStep5SupportMessage: Send this message to the support team:
integrations.veeqoStep5SupportText: "Can you assist me to create for my admin account api key in users, I cannot see them."
integrations.veeqoStep5WaitTime: The support team will open their system within 5-30 minutes (may vary on weekends and mornings) and notify you by email.
integrations.veeqoStep6Instructions1: Click Settings from the top menu
integrations.veeqoStep6ActionsDesc: Click the pencil icon under Actions next to your user. Scroll down and you'll see a mixed-character text in the API KEY section.
integrations.veeqoStep7Title: Enter the API Key in KolayXport
integrations.veeqoStep7Desc: Copy your API key and paste it into the Veeqo API Key field on the <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink> page.
integrations.veeqoStep7CaseSensitive: Characters are case-sensitive, so we recommend using copy-paste.
integrations.veeqoCongratsDesc: Your Veeqo integration is complete. You can now manage orders from all marketplaces connected to Veeqo through KolayXport.
integrations.shippoPlatformsDesc: By connecting your existing Shippo account to KolayXport (details on the "How to Use" page), you can pull data from popular e-commerce platforms and marketplaces that Shippo integrates with, such as:
integrations.shippoPlatformsNote: These lists contain the major platforms. For Shippo's up-to-date and complete integration list, please check Shippo's official resources. KolayXport can receive data from these platforms through your Shippo account.
integrations.shippingIntegrationDesc: For shipments you make through KolayXport, we currently use FedEx infrastructure. When you prepare your orders and make them ready for shipping, the delivery process will be managed through FedEx.
integrations.shippingIntegrationNote: Settings or options related to our FedEx integration (if user-manageable) will be detailed on the <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink> page or in the "How to Use" section.
integrations.etsyIntegrationDesc: You can use the Kolayxport Etsy Chrome Extension to automatically import your orders from Etsy Shop Manager to KolayXport. This extension securely transfers your Etsy orders from your browser to your KolayXport account.
integrations.securityNoApi: Does not require the Etsy API
integrations.securityNoRisk: No risk of blocking or suspension
integrations.chromeStep1Desc: Download the Kolayxport Etsy Chrome Extension directly from the link below:
integrations.chromeStep1Alt: You can also download from the Chrome Web Store:
integrations.chromeStep1NotAvailable: (may not be available if not yet published)
integrations.chromeStep2Desc: Extract the downloaded ZIP file and install it in Chrome:
integrations.chromeStep2Item1: Extract the downloaded kolayxport-etsy-extension-v5.3-multistore.zip file to a suitable location on your computer
integrations.chromeStep2Item2: Go to chrome://extensions/ in Chrome browser
integrations.chromeStep2Item3: Turn on "Developer mode" toggle in the top right corner
integrations.chromeStep2Item6: The extension is installed in Chrome! You'll see the Kolayxport icon in the top right corner.
integrations.chromeStep2Tip: To keep the extension always accessible, click the pin icon on the Chrome toolbar to pin it.
integrations.chromeStep3Desc: Sign in to your KolayXport account and make sure you're logged in.
integrations.chromeStep3AutoAuth: The extension will automatically detect your session and authenticate.
integrations.chromeStep4Desc: Sign in to your Etsy account and go to Shop Manager → Orders page.
integrations.chromeStep4AutoDetect: The extension will automatically detect your orders and start syncing.
integrations.chromeStep5Desc: Click the extension icon in Chrome to monitor the sync status:
integrations.chromeStep6Item1: Click "Import All Orders" button in the extension popup
integrations.chromeStep6Item2: Keep the Etsy Orders page open
integrations.chromeStep6Item3: The extension will automatically navigate through all pages and import orders
integrations.chromeStep6Note: This process may take 5-30 minutes depending on your order count.
integrations.autoSyncDesc: After setup is complete, new orders will automatically be imported to KolayXport every time you visit the Etsy Orders page. The duplicate prevention system ensures the same order is never imported twice.
integrations.troubleshootNoOrders: Make sure you're signed in to KolayXport and on the Etsy Orders page.
integrations.troubleshootAuthError: Sign out of KolayXport and sign in again.
integrations.troubleshootMissingOrders: Refresh the page and wait a few seconds.
integrations.troubleshootMoreHelp: For more help, contact <contactLink>our support team</contactLink>.
integrations.trendyolGuideDesc: Follow the steps below to automatically import your orders from your Trendyol store to KolayXport:
integrations.trendyolStep1Title: Sign In to Trendyol Seller Panel
integrations.trendyolStep1Desc: Sign in to the Trendyol Seller Panel (partner.trendyol.com) with your credentials.
integrations.trendyolStep2Desc: In the seller panel, you can find your API Key and Supplier ID usually under a menu like "Integration Info", "API Info", or similar.
integrations.trendyolStep2ApiSecret: In some cases, a Secret Key may be provided along with the API Key. For KolayXport, the API Key and Supplier ID are usually sufficient.
integrations.trendyolStep2Note: The Trendyol panel interface may be updated from time to time. If you have trouble finding your API credentials, you can get help from Trendyol Seller Support.
integrations.trendyolStep3Desc: Go to the Settings page and enter your Trendyol API Key and Supplier ID in the relevant fields.
integrations.trendyolStep3Tip: Using copy-paste when entering your API keys will prevent potential typos.
integrations.trendyolStep4Desc: After saving your credentials, your Trendyol orders will start syncing automatically.
integrations.trendyolStep4Note: If you experience any issues, you can reach us through our <supportLink>Support page</supportLink>.

howToUse.title: How to Use KolayXport?
howToUse.description: This guide will help you use KolayXport effectively and automate your e-commerce processes.
howToUse.veeqoIntro: Follow the steps below to import your order and product data from your Veeqo account to KolayXport. Make sure you have your Veeqo API key ready before starting.
howToUse.veeqoStep1Desc: Log in to your Veeqo account. You can usually find your API key in Veeqo's settings or integrations section.
howToUse.veeqoStep1Note: Veeqo's interface may change over time. Please refer to Veeqo's own help documentation for the most up-to-date information.
howToUse.veeqoStep2Desc: In KolayXport, go to the Settings page from the side menu or your profile.
howToUse.veeqoStep3Desc: Find the "Veeqo API Information" section on the Settings page. Enter your Veeqo API Key in the relevant field.
howToUse.veeqoStep3Note: We recommend using copy-paste when entering your API key to avoid potential typos.
howToUse.veeqoStep4Title: Save Settings and Wait for Sync
howToUse.veeqoStep4Desc: Click the "Save Veeqo Settings" button. When the connection is successful, your Veeqo data will start syncing with KolayXport. This process may take some time depending on the amount of data.
howToUse.veeqoWarning: If you experience issues, make sure your API key is correct and that API access permissions are active in your Veeqo account. Contact support if needed.
howToUse.shippoIntro: Follow the steps below to import your shipping and order data from your Shippo account to KolayXport. Make sure you have your Shippo Private API Token ready before starting.
howToUse.shippoStep1Title: Get Your Shippo Private API Token
howToUse.shippoStep1Desc: Log in to your Shippo account. You can usually find your Private API Token in Shippo's API settings or developer section.
howToUse.shippoStep1Note: Shippo's interface may change over time. Please refer to Shippo's own help documentation for the most up-to-date information.
howToUse.shippoStep2Desc: In KolayXport, go to the Settings page from the side menu or your profile.
howToUse.shippoStep3Desc: Find the "Shippo API Information" section on the Settings page. Enter your Shippo Private API Token in the relevant field.
howToUse.shippoStep3Note: We recommend using copy-paste when entering your API token to avoid potential typos.
howToUse.shippoStep4Title: Save Settings and Wait for Sync
howToUse.shippoStep4Desc: Click the "Save Shippo Settings" button. When the connection is successful, your Shippo data will start syncing with KolayXport.
howToUse.shippoWarning: If you experience issues, make sure your API token is correct and that necessary permissions are available in your Shippo account. Contact support if needed.
howToUse.otherGuidesDesc: Detailed guides for setting up direct integrations like Trendyol and Hepsiburada, managing shipping with FedEx, and using other KolayXport features will be available on this page soon.
howToUse.trendyolLink: For information about the Trendyol integration, check the Trendyol section on the Integrations and Guides page.
